asset.title: A Cozy Berry Moment

creativeDirectionOptions.prompt:
Create a cinematic 3D animated product story using the provided reference image of Berrywell Gold Black Raspberry Juice as the source of truth for the bottle, tube, labels, colors, proportions, cap, and all visible design details. Preserve the exact product appearance across scenes. Do not copy the reference image’s table setup, background, lighting, props, or camera angle; build a new original animated world around it.

Make the video feel like a premium emotional animated short film about comfort, warmth, and small everyday wellness rituals. The juice should feel magical, elegant, and comforting rather than like a normal ad.

Length: 15 seconds.
No text, no subtitles, no captions, no branding overlays, no end cards.

Scene 1 — Emotional discovery (0–4s)
A cozy evening kitchen in a warm, softly lit home. A childlike animated character or gentle family member opens a cupboard and discovers the Berrywell Gold Black Raspberry Juice glowing subtly in the darkness, as if it has been waiting to be part of a family ritual. Cinematic slow push-in, soft dust particles, warm window light, shallow depth of field, tender expression of curiosity.

Scene 2 — First connection (4–7s)
Close-up of small hands touching the elegant bottle and cylinder package with wonder. The character carefully lifts the bottle, admiring the deep berry color through glass. Tiny reflections, soft highlights on the label, tactile premium textures, gentle smile. Camera: smooth macro glide from label detail to the character’s eyes.

Scene 3 — Imagination / transformation (7–11s)
The room subtly transforms into a whimsical berry dreamscape inspired by the product: floating black raspberries, warm golden light ribbons, soft berry blossoms, a calm magical orchard atmosphere. The product remains physically accurate and prominent in the scene, shown as the source of this comforting imaginative world. Camera drifts through the dreamlike berries and returns to the bottle in a graceful orbit.

Scene 4 — Emotional payoff (11–13s)
The character pours a small serving into a glass and shares it with a loved one at the table. They smile softly, savoring the rich berry aroma and calm togetherness. Emotion should feel grounded, warm, and human, with the product clearly used as a daily wellness ritual. Slow, intimate camera move, gentle eye contact, comforting body language.

Scene 5 — Final cinematic ending (13–15s)
Premium hero shot of the Berrywell Gold Black Raspberry Juice standing elegantly on the table with a few black raspberries nearby, warm amber light and soft atmospheric particles. The bottle and tube package are both visible and accurate. Final frame feels like the last shot of a beautiful animated short film: refined, emotional, and serene. Hold the shot cleanly and end with a soft musical tail.

Visual style: high-end original 3D animation, cinematic rendering, warm emotional storytelling, stylized realism, expressive but believable character animation, premium environmental design, soft reflections, gentle magical realism, rich berry and gold palette, cozy shadows, subtle filmic depth.

Camera style: slow emotional push-ins, smooth tracking shots, expressive close-ups, subtle orbit moves, shallow depth of field, premium animated composition, minimal but meaningful cuts.

Lighting: warm window light, dreamy practical glow, golden highlights, deep berry accents, soft shadow gradients, magical atmospheric depth.

Audio: emotional orchestral music with soft piano and delicate string swells, subtle berry/orchard-inspired magical textures, warm room ambience, gentle pouring sound, soft glass clink, quiet family atmosphere. Audio should end cleanly with a warm musical tail.

Dialogue: optional and very minimal. If used, keep it natural and warm, such as a soft whispered line like **“This feels so special.”** Avoid narration overload.

Negative prompt: no readable text, no subtitles, no captions, no typography, no end card, no overlay graphics, no fake app UI, no exaggerated commercial packaging changes, no hallucinated product details, no altered bottle or tube shape, no incorrect label design, no scene copied from the reference image, no identical background or table setup, no duplicate products, no product morphing, no warped hands, no distorted anatomy, no uncanny faces, no broken lip-sync, no rushed speech, no robotic audio, no final-second boom or stinger, no cheap cartoon look, no anime style, no copyrighted characters, no brand impersonation, no visual clutter, no harsh lighting, no oversaturated colors.

asset.mainAssetCreativeDirectionPrompt:
Create an ultra-realistic, fast-paced UGC creator POV-style 15-second product video for **BERRYWELL Black raspberry Juice (700ml)**, using the attached reference image as the source of truth for the product’s appearance. Preserve the bottle shape, dark berry liquid, label placement, cap, and any visible packaging details exactly, but do not copy the reference image’s white background, studio composition, or camera angle. Make it feel like a real person filming on their phone at home in Singapore.

Goal: sell the juice as a simple daily wellness drink with a rich berry taste and an easy routine.

Structure the video like real UGC:

1) Hook / Problem
Open with the creator looking into the phone in a kitchen or home dining area, slightly tired and relatable: they’re bored of plain drinks and want something that feels refreshing but still part of a daily routine.
- Camera: arm-length selfie framing, slight hand shake, natural indoor light.
- Spoken line: **“Okay, I was so over plain drinks every day…”**

2) Product Solution
Quick punch-in reveal of the BERRYWELL bottle on a counter, then back to the creator holding it casually.
- Show the label clearly for a second, but keep it natural and handheld.
- Spoken line: **“Then I tried this black raspberry juice from Berrywell.”**

3) Real Demo
Show a believable real-life pour: open the bottle, pour a small amount into a glass, then dilute with cold water or serve chilled over ice. Show the deep dark berry color swirling in the glass.
- Camera: handheld close-up insert, slight reframing, quick cut back to face reaction.
- Add natural ambient sounds: bottle cap twist, liquid pour, glass clink.
- Spoken line: **“You only need a little bit, and it tastes so rich.”**

4) Satisfying Result
Show the finished drink with ice on the table, creator taking a sip, then a relieved smile and small surprised reaction.
- Emphasize the refreshed mood and easy daily-use vibe, not medical claims.
- Spoken line: **“It’s actually really nice chilled — like, super easy to keep in my routine.”**

5) Reaction
Creator gives a quick honest laugh or nod, holding the glass in frame.
- Spoken line: **“Okay wait… this is kind of my new go-to.”**

6) CTA
End with creator pointing gently toward the bottle on the table, still in casual selfie POV.
- Spoken line: **“If you want a simple berry drink, go check out Berrywell.”**

Visual direction:
- self-shot creator POV, casual home environment, phone-shot realism
- slight shake, imperfect framing, quick punch-ins, fast but clear pacing
- product shown in hand, on counter, and in poured glass
- keep product accurate to the reference image across all shots
- use natural colors: deep berry reds, dark plum tones, soft kitchen neutrals
- no polished ad look, no cinematic lighting, no tripod feel

Editing and pacing:
- quick jump cuts every 1–3 seconds
- one or two punch-in zooms on the bottle and poured drink
- minimal transitions, creator-style cut rhythm
- maintain a believable real-life UGC pace

Audio:
- natural female or male creator voice, casual and unpolished
- light ambient room tone, soft TikTok-style background music low in the mix
- bottle cap twist, pour sound, ice clink, light sip sound
- voice should stay clearly audible and conversational
- end cleanly without a final sound hit

Important product details to naturally imply visually, without reading them aloud:
- 700ml bottle
- black raspberry / bokbunja juice
- premium Korean product
- daily drinking vibe
- serve chilled or diluted
- rich berry color and taste

Negative prompt:
No subtitles, captions, readable text overlays, end cards, fake social media UI, polished commercial look, cinematic shots, tripod shots, CGI, fake textures, staged acting, overproduced lighting, exaggerated enthusiasm, unsupported health or medical claims, invented certifications, invented awards, distorted bottle shape, wrong label, wrong cap, incorrect packaging, product inconsistency between shots, copied white studio background from the reference image, copied composition from the reference image, additional brand logos, third-party brand marks, warped hands, broken lip-sync, unreadable text, morphing objects, final-second boom or stinger.

styleAsset.title: Animated Story
styleAsset.goal: Heartwarming 3D animated product stories with playful characters, magical imagination, and an emotional hero ending.
styleAsset.selectedCreativeDirectionPrompt:
## Style Prompt

Create a cinematic 3D animated product story using the promoted item context and any provided reference image as the source of truth. The AI must carefully analyze the promoted item and automatically generate a heartwarming animated storyline inspired by its visual personality, emotional vibe, colors, textures, purpose, shape language, category, and overall aesthetic.

The final video should feel like a premium animated short film: emotional, magical, cinematic, playful, visually beautiful, and deeply human.

The promoted item should NEVER feel like a normal advertisement. Instead, transform it into an emotional animated experience centered around friendship, comfort, imagination, adventure, wonder, nostalgia, creativity, warmth, or emotional connection.

Do not imitate or reference any specific animation studio, franchise, character universe, copyrighted style, or protected IP. Use a high-end original 3D animated short-film look with warm cinematic storytelling.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Product Accuracy
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Use the provided inputs as truth.

For physical products, the reference image is the source of truth for the product's visible appearance. Do not hallucinate or invent details that are not visible in the reference image. Keep the product accurate to its colors, proportions, materials, textures, packaging structure, shape language, design details, and facial features if applicable.

For digital offers, services, or businesses, do not invent a fake physical product. Represent the promoted item through an animated character moment, symbolic object, creator/customer experience, community scene, workspace, event, dream sequence, or abstract visual metaphor that truthfully fits the offer.

Creatively build the story around the promoted item or offer. Do not redesign it into a different product.

Do not add new logos, brand marks, IP characters, copyrighted brand elements, fake app interfaces, branding overlays, typography, or end cards. If the reference image contains branding, preserve product identity through safe, product-owned, or non-IP visual details. Do not invent, imitate, or emphasize third-party IP, famous brand marks, or protected characters.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Product Analysis
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Before generating the story, deeply analyze:
- what the promoted item emotionally feels like
- what type of animated world matches it
- what emotional theme fits it best
- what kind of character would naturally interact with it
- what magical or emotional scenario connects naturally to the product category or offer
- what environment emotionally supports the promoted item

Examples:
- toy or game: magical friendship adventure
- coffee or tea: rainy-day comfort story
- headphones or music offer: musical dream world
- blanket or home product: bedtime fantasy journey
- snack or drink: whimsical comfort adventure
- bottle or outdoor product: survival friendship story
- perfume or scent product: magical memory fantasy
- stationery or creative product: imagination world coming alive
- skincare or wellness offer: cozy self-care dream sequence
- course, workshop, or service: animated transformation through learning, confidence, or community
- business or brand: symbolic animated world that expresses the brand promise

The story should feel emotionally grounded and universally relatable while still feeling whimsical and magical.
